description.raw: '''Innate:''' When '''Draven''' catches a ''[[File:Draven Spinning Axe.png|20xpx|border|link=Draven#Spinning Axe|An icon for Draven's ability Spinning Axe]] [[Draven#Spinning Axe|Spinning Axe]]'', kills a non-champion, or destroys a [[File:Turret icon.png|20px|link=Turret|An icon representing the keyword Turret]] [[:Turret|turret]], he gains a [[File:Stack icon.png|20px|link=Stack|An icon representing the keyword Stack]] [[:Stack|stack]] of ''Adoration''.
description.text: Innate: When Draven catches a Spinning Axe, kills a non-champion, or destroys a turret, he gains a stack of Adoration.

description2.raw: When '''Draven''' kills an enemy [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]], he consumes all of his ''Adoration'' stacks and gains [[File:Gold colored icon.svg|20xpx|link=Gold|An icon representing Gold]] 25 + (2 × stacks) '''bonus''' gold.
description2.text: When Draven kills an enemy champion, he consumes all of his Adoration stacks and gains 25 + (2 × stacks) bonus gold.

description3.raw: '''Draven''' loses 50% of his ''Adoration'' stacks upon [[File:Death icon.svg|20px|link=Death|An icon representing the keyword Death]] [[:Death|death]].
description3.text: Draven loses 50% of his Adoration stacks upon death.

notes.text:
Upon reaching 150 Adoration stacks, and every 100 stacks thereafter, as well as when he cashes at least 150 stacks in, Draven automatically sends a chat message notifying all players.
A chat message will display to all players whenever:
* League of Draven grants over 300 gold.
* League of Draven gets reduced.
None of the parts of League of Draven require actually using a Spinning Axe for a kill to get Adoration stacks, as well as to cash Adoration stacks.
League of Draven will trigger upon receiving an assist on an enemy executed by Pyke's Death from Below.[https://www.reddit.com/r/leagueoflegends/comments/8je2sr/comment/dyz51mx/ Reav3 confirming Death from Below synergy is intentional]
When receiving gold from an ally executing a minion through Shared Riches ( World Atlas, Runic Compass), Draven is also awarded a Strike stack.(bug)
* A Strike stack lasts up to 10 seconds or until Draven fails to catch an axe or a nearby minion dies without him killing it. Upon reacing 6 stacks, Draven consumes the stacks to gain 2 stacks of Adoration.
* Other sources of gaining Strike stacks were removed in patch V25.06.
